steps.text: 10:32 P.M. \ Light drizzle
Chernobog - Post-battle Ruins

steps.name: Brave Child
steps.text: Hey—Hey! Is anyone here?!

steps.name: Brave Child
steps.text: It's gotten really dark... I just walked past the school, the cake shop, and the tailor shop that Rolena's mom used to run...

steps.name: Brave Child
steps.text: If I keep going straight, I'll be in the next district.

steps.name: Brave Child
steps.text: Dammit... This road is barely walkable. Those nutjobs with the masks... Everything's changed all of a sudden, thanks to them.

steps.name: Brave Child
steps.text: Yuri! Yuri, where are you?!

steps.name: Brave Child
steps.text: We were together just a moment ago... I was just trying to get us some water that we can drink!

steps.name: Brave Child
steps.text: Yuri's the youngest, and he's the most hurt. Where could he have gone by himself? Right, his wound was still bleeding... If I look out for the smell of blood... Uhh... It smells like blood everywhere.

steps.name: Brave Child
steps.text: Ugh, it stinks.

steps.name: Brave Child
steps.text: No, I can't throw up. It took Oleg so long to find us dinner in the ruins.

steps.name: Brave Child
steps.text: Yuri—
*Whimpers*...

steps.name: Brave Child
steps.text: Is that sound coming from behind the wall? A small animal, maybe?  Hmm, probably not. Everything that was alive in this street ran away a long time ago. We're the only ones left.
*Whimpers*...

steps.name: Brave Child
steps.text: There it is again. It doesn't sound like the wind. Could it really be...?

steps.name: Brave Child
steps.text: Yuri! Yuri, is that you?

steps.name: Brave Child
steps.text: It quieted down. Am I too far away? What was behind the wall again...? The department store's old storeroom?

steps.name: Brave Child
steps.text: The storeroom's been empty the whole time, and the adults would never let us close to it. Oleg even said before that he'd help us sneak inside one day.

steps.name: Brave Child
steps.text: Did Yuri come in here by himself? It's so dark... I can't see through the gaps. Dammit, I guess I'm gonna have to climb inside.

steps.name: Brave Child
steps.text: It's even darker in here. My face's all sticky... Is it the rain that dripped in from outside? Urgh, it smells...

steps.name: Brave Child
steps.text: Now I remember... The girls in school said there's something weird inside the storeroom.

steps.name: Brave Child
steps.text: It's gotta be fake.

steps.name: Brave Child
steps.text: But... I've already seen so many weird things going on these past few days...

steps.name: Brave Child
steps.text: No, don't think about that right now, Anton. Don't be scared. You still need to find Yuri.
*Whimpers*...

steps.name: Brave Child
steps.text: Someone's crying! Someone's crying over on that side! Now I heard it this time!

steps.name: Brave Child
steps.text: Yuri, is that you?

steps.name: Scared Child
steps.text: Anton...? Anton?

steps.name: Brave Child
steps.text: Yeah, it's me. I'm here. You don't need to be scared no more. I'll climb over there. Give me a second.

steps.name: Scared Child
steps.text: Help... Help me...

steps.name: Brave Child
steps.text: Hang in there. I'm almost there. What happened anyway? Why'd you run this far on your own all a sudden?

steps.name: Brave Child
steps.text: Isn't your leg hurt...?

steps.name: Scared Child
steps.text: Uhh... *Sobs*... T-There was a monster...

steps.name: Brave Child
steps.text: A monster? What are you talking about, Yuri? Do you have a fever?

steps.name: Scared Child
steps.text: A monster... brought me here...

steps.name: Brave Child
steps.text: The monster you're talking about... What does it look like?

steps.name: Scared Child
steps.text: I... I couldn't get a good look... I think it had black claws... And it had red eyes! It stared at me. I-I was so scared, I didn't know what was going on at all.

steps.name: Brave Child
steps.text: Black claws and red eyes? I think I heard of that before.

steps.name: Brave Child
steps.text: Oh yeah, that's the ghost story that Lina from school talked about, right?

steps.name: Scared Child
steps.text: Yeah... Lina said... She said any kids that don't go to bed at night will get a visit from the monster.

steps.name: Scared Child
steps.text: It'll keep staring at you, and if your eyes are open and lock onto her red eyes, your soul will get sucked out right away.

steps.name: Scared Child
steps.text: You'll turn into something like a marionette. You'll climb off your bed with the monster and follow it outside and onto the street. Then you'll keep following it... until you reach its nest.

steps.name: Scared Child
steps.text: There, the monster will hang you up on the eaves... Just like how we hang sausages at home...

steps.name: Scared Child
steps.text: And when it's hungry... It'll come suck your blood, one mouthful after another until your body's bone dry.

steps.name: Scared Child
steps.text: *Sobs*... Anton, I can't possibly have...

steps.name: Brave Child
steps.text: Stop it. You're scaring yourself. This is just something the adults made up to get us to go to bed early, I'm sure of it.

steps.name: Scared Child
steps.text: R-Really?

steps.name: Brave Child
steps.text: Well, think about it. Did it hang you up?

steps.name: Scared Child
steps.text: I... There's something holding my leg... Somewhere up high...

steps.name: Brave Child
steps.text: What?!

steps.name: Scared Child
steps.text: So... What Lina said's actually real, right?

steps.name: Scared Child
steps.text: *sobs*... Anton... I don't wanna be eaten by the monster...

steps.name: Brave Child
steps.text: It's okay. I'll be there soon. We just gotta be fast. I'll carry you back before that mon... Before whatever it is comes back.

steps.name: Scared Child
steps.text: Yeah... N-No... Anton, stay away! Go back!

steps.name: Brave Child
steps.text: I can see you now, Yuri—

steps.name: Brave Child
steps.text: What's this?!

a.text: A nightmare that walks the night.
A monster who kidnaps children and sucks their blood dry.
They have eyes that glow crimson red.

steps.name: Brave Child
steps.text: Ahhhh—!
Got you now.

steps.name: Brave Child
steps.text: No... Stay away! Don't come any closer! I... I won't let you hurt Yuri!
Me, hurt him? Boy, what do you think I'm trying to do?

steps.name: Brave Child
steps.text: You want to suck his blood, you blood-sucking monster!
Well, it's been a long while since anyone has called me that.
Yes, that's right. I'm a Vampire.
My, my, your reaction's not bad for someone who looks so frail.
But you know, if we're going there, you'll need a bigger brick to throw at me.
I'm a Vampire! We are swift beyond measure, and rank among the mightiest devil races! And have you seen these fangs?
I can easily tear a cystybeast's neck apart.
Holding still? Smart choice.

steps.name: Brave Child
steps.text: Monster, let Yuri go. He's hurt, and he's lost a lot of blood. He definitely doesn't have as much blood as I do.

steps.name: Brave Child
steps.text: You can hang me up. When you're hungry, suck my blood.

steps.name: Scared Child
steps.text: No, Anton... Don't do that...
Very well, since you've found this place.

steps.name: Brave Child
steps.text: She's so fast! I can't move my hand...!

steps.name: Brave Child
steps.text: Ugh? It hurts!

steps.name: Brave Child
steps.text: I can't dodge it... Is this how it's like... to get bitten?
There you go.

steps.name: Brave Child
steps.text: There I go...? I'm still standing upright... I don't feel dizzy either...
Just that bit of blood will do. You are really healthy. It shouldn't leave you with any side effects.

steps.name: Brave Child
steps.text: So... Are you gonna take me home... and make me sausage?
Sausage? Is that some Ursus specialty? It sounds nice. If I ever get to come here again after I'm done with this job, maybe I'll give it a try.
Compass? Compass, are you there?

steps.name: Guard Operator
steps.text: *Cough*, I'm here, Dr. Warfarin.

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: I'm working so hard, I'm practically sweating blood, and here you are, just standing there, watching the show.

steps.name: Guard Operator
steps.text: Haha, well, I only just got here. Besides, it looks like you're enjoying yourself.

steps.name: Brave Child
steps.text: Doc...tor?

steps.name: Brave Child
steps.text: You mean, this blood-sucking monster is a doctor?

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: Look at this, Compass. The kids just won't stop calling me a blood-sucking monster. Don't you think I'm like a saint for letting them off with just a little scare?

steps.name: Brave Child
steps.text: You're... scaring us?

steps.name: Guard Operator
steps.text: Let me explain.

steps.name: Guard Operator
steps.text: Little buddy? I found your friend while I was out on a mission. He was all alone, and it looked like he was hurt pretty bad.

steps.name: Guard Operator
steps.text: I was worried about his safety, so I brought him here. He was kind of drifting off and passed out halfway through, so I couldn't explain to him what was going on.

steps.name: Guard Operator
steps.text: Dr. Warfarin is one of our top doctors. She's very experienced. You can trust her to patch your friend up.

steps.name: Guard Operator
steps.text: Oh, and you know how she took a bit of your blood just now? She was just taking a blood sample to run some tests.

steps.name: Brave Child
steps.text: Tests...?

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: Okay, the results are out. What's that Ursus saying again? Hmm, this young man is as lively as a wild burdenbeast.

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: Congratulations, boy. You are not infected yet.

steps.name: Brave Child
steps.text: Infected... You mean Oripathy?

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: That's right. These days, you're probably one of the luckiest ones around if you're both alive and uninfected in Chernobog.

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: Your friend there isn't quite as lucky.

steps.name: Brave Child
steps.text: Is something wrong with Yuri?

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: All I can say is we took care of him before it's too late, and you've got me. If Folinic had been in charge of the area, he probably wouldn't have gotten such a wonderful patch up job.

steps.name: Guard Operator
steps.text: Ahem... If she heard that, I'm sure she'd be mad.

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: And what do I care if she's mad? She still has much to learn.

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: Can she figure out right away where the Originium crystals are building up just going by the changes in the smell of his blood?

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: For patients like him, who just started to show symptoms, we need to do more than just take care of their wounds to keep the infection from progressing. We also need to prevent the Originium that's already in their bodies from forming leisons around the wounds.

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: The suppressants that are out on the market can only alleviate symptoms. Even if I'm on the case, the most I can do is minimize the risk of the disease getting any worse.

steps.name: Brave Child
steps.text: Did you hang Yuri's leg up like that to help him?

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: Well...

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: Yeah... I guess? This is an idea I've wanted to try out for a while. In his case, it should be more effective by a few percentage points.

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: It's so low, I guess it's probably within the margin of error? I might need to find a few more patients to test this out on...

steps.name: Guard Operator
steps.text: Ahem, Dr. Warfarin, if you keep going, the young gentlemen will start trembling again.

steps.name: Scared Child
steps.text: *Whimpers*...

steps.name: Brave Child
steps.text: I get it, you saved us.

steps.name: Brave Child
steps.text: Thanks...

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: You can thank me later. We need to keep your friend, this Yuri boy, under observation to see how his condition turns out.

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: If he actually becomes Infected...

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: Well, let's not go into that right now.

steps.name: Guard Operator
steps.text: Hey, Anton? You can rest up a little here with Yuri. Once it's bright outside, I'll take you two to our camp.

steps.name: Brave Child
steps.text: Your camp?

steps.name: Guard Operator
steps.text: That's right. We have a camp here. We'll be pulling out of Chernobog soon. When that happens, we'll escort you two to a nearby Ursus city.

steps.name: Guard Operator
steps.text: That is... if Yuri doesn't show any signs of further infection.

steps.name: Brave Child
steps.text: There's Oleg and the others too. There are five of us. We're together.

steps.name: Guard Operator
steps.text: Is that so? Okay. I'll look for them, then. Dr. Warfarin will give them a checkup too.

steps.name: Guard Operator
steps.text: If all of you stay together, your will to live on will be stronger too.

steps.name: Brave Child
steps.text: Doctor...?

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: Hm?

steps.name: Brave Child
steps.text: I have another question...

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: What is it?

steps.name: Brave Child
steps.text: Are you... really a blood-sucking monster?

steps.name: Guard Operator
steps.text: *cough*, *cough*.

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: (Brandishes fangs)

steps.name: Guard Operator
steps.text: Makes you want to take a step back, huh? No? What a brave kid.

steps.name: Guard Operator
steps.text: To be honest, I have known Dr. Warfarin for a long time, and I know she may seem like she has a few screws loose...

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: I heard that.

steps.name: Guard Operator
steps.text: *cough*, she's a very skilled doctor. It's just... when you're strapped on the operating table all of a sudden, it does kinda give you chills.

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: That's just your instincts at work. I forgive you.

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: It's like sandworms running into a Metal Crab, or some other tiny meatbeasts running into more ferocious beasts. Of course you'd be scared coming face to face with a Vampire.

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: And you better stay scared. Most Vampires out there aren't nearly as nice as me or Closure.

steps.name: Guard Operator
steps.text: Ha... Haha.

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: Hm... Back to our little buddy's question—

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: Maybe half-and-half?

steps.name: Brave Child
steps.text: Half-and-half?

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: My interest in blood doesn't manifest as thirst anymore.

steps.name: Brave Child
steps.text: So... a monster then?

steps.name: Brave Child
steps.text: So you don't get mad... if you're called a monster?

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: Well... to you, I am a monster, no doubt about that.

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: I've never wished for you people to treat me as your own kind, and I don't see the other races as my equals either.

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: And well, if I'm a monster just because I'm unlike the others... then everyone out there can be called a monster too.

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: For example, if your friend Yuri actually becomes infected, then a lot of people will call him a monster.

steps.name: Brave Child
steps.text: I won't. I won't call him a monster.

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: What about the others? It's won't be easy for you to change how they see him.

steps.name: Brave Child
steps.text: If they insist on calling him a monster, I'll fight them off.

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: See? You're mad, aren't you?

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: You'll fight them off, and they'll fight back. Even if nobody dies in all that fighting, it'll be a waste of time, don't you think?

steps.name: Brave Child
steps.text: A waste of time...?

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: Yes, a waste of time. While you're angry, your friend may die of his disease.

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: If you take a step back and think it through slowly, you'll find that, instead of being angry, it makes more sense to spend your energy working out more important or meaningful things.

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: For you, hm... I suppose that's figuring out how you want to live?

steps.name: Brave Child
steps.text: Live... Right, we want to live.

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: That's right! And if you want to live a better life, you need to learn to accept that you are different and then figure out how to get along with others.

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: One more thing, buddy. Once you grow up, be sure to travel to all kinds of places and see what it's like everywhere.

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: That way, you will probably come to understand that... being seen as a monster is nothing worth getting angry over.
